mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.owner_code AS ownerCode, o.name, o.password, c.id AS companyNumericId, c.company_id AS companyCode, c.expiration_date AS expirationDate FROM owner o INNER JOIN company c ON c.owner_id = o.id WHERE UPPER(o.owner_code) = UPPER(#{loginId}) AND UPPER(TRIM(c.company_id)) = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE owner SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{ownerId}
